summary_zh: 今日泰國華商動態聚焦擴產與高階認證：jpp-KY經寶精密通過空中巴士關鍵特殊製程驗證，並因AI與航太訂單預估明年營收雙位數成長、將加大泰國投資；海爾投資52.5億銖於羅勇府建洗衣機廠；泰國副總理亦率中國投資者考察宋卡府，評估無人機與機器人生產基地。顯示客戶對海外產能與嚴格品質驗證的要求同步升高。
summary_en: Chinese-owned makers deepen Thailand bets: jpp-KY passed Airbus special-process validation and will expand Thai investment on AI/aerospace orders; Haier invests THB5.25bn in a Rayong washer plant; Chinese investors eye Songkhla for drones and robotics. Overseas capacity and strict certification matter.

items.summary_zh: 泰國副總理率中國投資者考察宋卡府工業區，考慮設立無人機與機器人生產基地。
items.summary_en: A Thai minister led Chinese investors to survey Songkhla industrial estate, considering a drone and robot production base.

items.title: jpp-KY 狂攬空巴 A350逾20項製程認證 下一步叩關波音
items.summary_zh: jpp-KY經寶精密通過空中巴士關鍵特殊製程驗證，取得航太高階製造突破。
items.summary_en: jpp-KY (Thailand precision sheet-metal maker) says it passed Airbus key special-process certification, a breakthrough in high-end aerospace manufacturing.

items.title: AI、航太雙引擎帶動 jpp-KY明年雙位數成長
items.summary_zh: jpp-KY預估明年營收雙位數成長，受AI與航太訂單帶動，將全面加大泰國投資。
items.summary_en: jpp-KY expects double-digit revenue growth next year on AI and aerospace orders and will step up investment in Thailand.

items.title: 海爾砸52.5億銖 羅勇府興建洗衣機工廠

items.summary_en: Haier announced a 5.25 billion baht investment to build a washing machine factory in Rayong, Thailand.
